customers_say: Customers are impressed with the smart lock's reliability, noting that the face unlock feature works quickly every time, and appreciate its user-friendly app interface. The lock features a simple door handle design that matches well with home decor, and customers find it convenient to use. They praise its build quality and installation process, and consider it a good value for money.

reviews.author: Satyam Singh
reviews.title: Excellent smart lock with great build quality
reviews.body: Really impressed with the Native Lock Ultra. The build quality feels premium, installation was smooth, and the lock works reliably. The smart features are convenient and make everyday access much easier. Overall, a great product for the price and definitely worth recommending.

reviews.author: Anish Joshi
reviews.title: Native Lock Ultra review
reviews.body: Excellent smart lock! Great build quality and very convenient to use. The fingerprint unlock is quick and reliable. Very happy with the Native lock.

reviews.author: Gagan Deep
reviews.title: Great Smart Lock with Premium Features
reviews.body: Great smart lock! Premium design, easy to use, and the app features like remote unlocking, live view and instant notifications work really well. Feels secure and premium. Happy with the purchase! Worth the price.

reviews.author: Nishtha
reviews.title: Better than I expected
reviews.body: I bought this lock because of the classy design and it has proven to be as useful as it has been aesthetic. Didn’t think I would use the two way talk feature a lot but it’s quite convenient! Getting deliveries while no one is at home has become so easy now. I feel like it’s worth it to even consider upgrading from an existing smart lock to this one, and even more so if you have a manual lock

reviews.author: Tamal Ghosh
reviews.title: Not flawless
reviews.body: This product is good but it has a major design flaw. None of my guests able to open the door when they leave the home. I always have to open the door if the visitor is new. Opening door from the inside is non intuitive, hidden behind the handle and very confusing. Nobody still today able to open the door in the first time without asking us to open the door for them. I think I have been using it for 3 months now and still finding a smart one who can open the door in first trial. May be I sound like too dramatic and making it a big deal on small issue.
